We need to determine crimes for the defendant(s). The case: The plaintiff (self-prosecutor) is Yang (town party secretary). The defendant is He 2 (village resident). He 2 alleged that Yang beat him, but evidence shows he injured himself (head injury from falling, earlier fracture from June). He also spread false statements about Yang, via TV, microblog, etc., defaming him. The court finds He 2's statements are false, intentional defamation, causing serious damage to reputation. So crime: defamation (诽谤罪). Also possibly "扰乱公共秩序" but that was already administrative. The main criminal charge is defamation (slander). In Chinese criminal law, defamation is a crime under Article 246 (侮辱、诽谤罪). So answer: 诽谤罪.
